findings.title: Encryption failures return plaintext for storage
findings.explanation: Any exception from cipher.encrypt causes the function to return the original plaintext as a successful result. A storage caller can therefore persist sensitive data unencrypted, violating the function's explicit contract.
findings.recommendation: Propagate the encryption exception or raise a dedicated error so callers cannot mistake plaintext for ciphertext.
findings.suggested_test: Use a cipher whose encrypt method raises an exception. Assert that encrypt_for_storage raises and does not return plaintext; in a storage integration test, assert that no write occurs after this failure.
